description_en: Sets a password that you can use to remotely connect to a visualization service in a cluster over the virtual network console (VNC)
description_zh: 调用ModifyVisualServicePasswd设置指定集群的VNC远程可视化服务的连接密码
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc modify-visual-service-passwd --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --runas-user root --runas-user-password 21450000 --passwd 12540000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVisualServicePasswd

parameters.description_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.
parameters.description_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The username of the cluster. Set the value to root.
parameters.description_zh: 集群的用户名。当前仅支持root用户。
parameters.help_en: The username of the cluster. Set the value to root
parameters.help_zh: 集群的用户名。当前仅支持root用户
parameters.name: runas_user

parameters.description_en: The password that corresponds to the username specified by RunasUser.
parameters.help_en: The password that corresponds to the username specified by RunasUser
parameters.name: runas_user_password

parameters.description_en:
The password that you can use to remotely connect to the visualization service over the VNC. The password must be 6 characters in length and must contain letters and digits.

>  You must call the API operation over HTTPS to ensure that the password remains confidential.
parameters.description_zh:
修改后的VNC远程可视化服务的连接密码。长度为6个字符，必须同时包含英文字母和数字。
>请务必使用HTTPS协议调用API以避免可能发生的密码泄露。
